title: MCP job store
description: <prefix>.json in the MCP job store directory (CW_MCP_JOB_STORE, default <reports root>/mcp-jobs), written by mcp/jobs.mjs after every change to one server process's jobs, so a restarted server can answer run_checks_result for them. One file per process; a job still queued or running in a file whose process has exited is reported as interrupted and never re-run. The runner's log tail and the text an injection signal matched are not written here.

prefix.description: The job id prefix this process issued; also the file name.

pid.description: The server process, checked for liveness before an in-flight job is called interrupted.

savedAt.description: When this file was last written, ISO 8601.

issued.description: How many ids this process issued, so an id that left retention is told apart from one never issued.

request.description: What was asked: repo, manifest, group.

interruptedAt.description: When this process interrupted the job at shutdown.

result.description: The run_checks result, when the runner got that far.

injection.description: Signals over the inputs and the output, each with its ledger write counts. A signal carries id, why and span; the matched text is not stored.
